title: Priority Queue Emplace
description: Construct element in-place in priority queue
explanation: emplace constructs the element directly in the underlying container, avoiding a temporary copy.
code:
priority_queue<pair<int,int>> pq;
pq.emplace(1, 2);  // constructs pair in-place

title: Priority Queue Swap
description: Swap contents of two priority queues
explanation: swap() exchanges the contents (including the underlying container and comparator) of two priority queues.

title: Priority Queue Underlying Container
description: Access the underlying container type of priority_queue
explanation: priority_queue internally uses a container (default vector) and the heap algorithms (push_heap, pop_heap, make_heap, sort_heap).

title: Priority Queue Lambda Comparator
description: Use lambda as comparator for priority_queue
explanation: Lambda comparators allow custom heap ordering without writing a functor struct.

title: Priority Queue With Custom Structs
explanation: Priority queues work with custom structs by overloading operator< or providing a comparator.

title: Priority Queue Heap Algorithms
description: Using make_heap, push_heap, pop_heap, sort_heap directly
explanation: The underlying heap algorithms give more control than priority_queue alone. Useful for in-place heap operations.

title: Priority Queue For Dijkstra Shortest Path
explanation: Dijkstra uses a min-heap of (distance, node) pairs to efficiently find shortest paths.

title: Priority Queue Median Maintenance
description: Track median using two priority queues
explanation: Use a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half to maintain the median in O(log n) per insertion.

title: Priority Queue With Unique Elements
description: Priority queue with deduplication using a side set
explanation: priority_queue doesn't support dedup natively. Use an unordered_set alongside to track processed elements.

title: Priority Queue As Min Heap Default Comparator
description: Using a custom pair comparator for complex min-heap ordering
explanation: For min-heap of pairs, greater compares lexicographically. For custom ordering, provide a comparator that returns true when a should come AFTER b.
